boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten recurring Roger Williams University ceremonies, campus events, and community rituals documented by the university.

cards.title: Begin with bagpipes and a pledge
cards.subtitle: Annual new-student Convocation
cards.notes: Attend the formal welcome in the Campus Recreation Center and listen for the bagpipes before new Hawks take the Academic Integrity Pledge.
cards.short_summary: RWU’s annual ceremony formally welcomes new students into the university community.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU identifies Convocation as an annual tradition marking the beginning of a student’s time as a Hawk; students take the Academic Integrity Pledge during the ceremony.
cards.access_notes: RWU lists the 2026 ceremony in the Campus Recreation Center; follow Student Programs guidance for attendance and accommodations.

cards.title: Make the September welcome circuit
cards.subtitle: WOW new-student programming
cards.notes: Use Hawk Link or the Roger Link app to find a Weeks of Welcome event that fits your interests, then meet people beyond your residence hall.
cards.short_summary: A series of events led by Student Programs, campus departments, and student organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU says Weeks of Welcome brings new students together through events hosted by student organizations and Student Life departments, with all students able to view events through Hawk Link or Roger Link.
cards.source_title: New Student Events | Roger Williams University
cards.access_notes: Programming varies by year; consult Hawk Link or the Roger Link app for current events and locations.

cards.title: Open the year with 1, 2, 3 Weekend
cards.subtitle: CEN Labor Day Weekend programming
cards.notes: Check the Campus Entertainment Network schedule over Labor Day Weekend for the traditional illusionist or hypnotist show, outdoor movie, and Fall Carnival.
cards.short_summary: A Campus Entertainment Network weekend that opens the academic year with several shared events.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU describes 1, 2, 3 Weekend as Campus Entertainment Network Labor Day Weekend programming with a hypnotist or illusionist show, outdoor movie, and annual Fall Carnival.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled over Labor Day Weekend; verify the current program and locations with Campus Entertainment Network.

cards.title: See D’Angelo Common light up
cards.subtitle: December holiday-tree lighting
cards.notes: Gather on D’Angelo Common for the non-denominational holiday-tree lighting and stay for live performances by RWU performing groups.
cards.short_summary: A December tree-lighting event pairing seasonal lights with student performance.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU says Winter Illuminations includes lighting a non-denominational holiday tree on D’Angelo Common and live music from RWU performing groups.
cards.access_notes: Held in December; confirm the year’s event details with Student Programs, Leadership, & Orientation.

cards.title: Catch student bands at Hawk the Block
cards.subtitle: Annual WQRI spring concert
cards.notes: Bring friends to the WQRI 88.3 FM spring concert and explore the student craft fair and food trucks alongside student and local performers.
cards.short_summary: The campus radio station’s annual spring concert with music, food trucks, and a craft fair.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU identifies Hawk the Block as WQRI 88.3 FM’s annual spring concert featuring student bands, local talent, food trucks, and a student craft fair.
cards.access_notes: Held in April; check WQRI and university event listings for the current location and program.

cards.title: Decorate against the 30-minute clock
cards.subtitle: Inter-Class Council annual competition
cards.notes: Form a team for the Inter-Class Council’s timed cake-decorating competition; its charitable beneficiary is tied to the year’s decorating theme.
cards.short_summary: A timed April decorating contest whose proceeds support a charitable organization.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU describes Cake Off as an Inter-Class Council annual competition where teams have 30 minutes to decorate cakes and proceeds go to a charity connected to the theme.
cards.access_notes: Held in April; consult Inter-Class Council or the university calendar for participation details.

cards.title: Take a finals break at Late Night Breakfast
cards.subtitle: End-of-classes breakfast in Upper Commons
cards.notes: Stop by Upper Commons on the last day of classes for the themed breakfast served by RWU faculty and staff before final-exam studying.
cards.short_summary: A faculty- and staff-served breakfast held at the close of each semester’s classes.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU says Late Night Breakfast occurs on the last day of classes each semester in Upper Commons and is served by faculty and staff; no meal plan is required.
cards.access_notes: Held in December and May on the last day of classes; no meal plan is required, per RWU.

cards.title: End the year with Spring Week
cards.subtitle: Campus Entertainment Network April series
cards.notes: Follow the week’s schedule for Quad Fest, the Spring Concert, comedian event, Block Party, and fireworks over Mount Hope Bay.
cards.short_summary: A staple April series that marks the end of RWU’s academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU calls Spring Week a staple of the spring semester and lists Quad Fest, the annual Spring Concert, a comedian event, Block Party, and fireworks over Mount Hope Bay.
cards.access_notes: Held in April; confirm individual event locations, schedules, and weather plans through the university calendar.

cards.title: Return for the Hawk Spirit weekend
cards.subtitle: Annual fall campus gathering
cards.notes: Plan around the October weekend to reconnect with family or alumni and choose from the university’s traditional campus events and athletic competitions.
cards.short_summary: A time-honored fall weekend bringing students, families, and alumni together on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU describes Homecoming & Family Weekend as a time-honored tradition where families connect with students, alumni reconnect, and events showcase Hawk Spirit.
cards.source_title: Homecoming & Family Weekend | Roger Williams University
cards.access_notes: RWU lists Homecoming & Family Weekend 2026 for October 16–18; some events require registration or tickets.

cards.title: Watch the Captain’s Cup Regatta
cards.subtitle: Annual RWU Sailing reunion race
cards.notes: Head to the Bready Sailing Center deck during Homecoming Weekend to watch the Captain’s Cup racing and cheer on the returning sailing community.
cards.short_summary: An annual sailing reunion event held as part of Homecoming & Family Weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU lists the Captain’s Cup Regatta as its 23rd annual event in 2026, with sailing racing hosted from the Bready Sailing Center during Homecoming & Family Weekend.
cards.source_title: Homecoming & Family Weekend | Roger Williams University
cards.access_notes: RWU schedules the 2026 Captain’s Cup during Homecoming Weekend; participant meals and dinner are ticketed.
